tmp:2905: kasheh me'od — the state of being 'very difficult/heavy,' describing the beginning (hatchalah) of charity and every divine service, per 'all beginnings are hard'
tmp:2906: the required act of opening an opening (petach) at the start of a path — the necessity to breach an entryway before entering any way of divine service
tmp:2907: entering that path and that service — the act of stepping into a specific derekh/avodah of serving God through its newly opened doorway
tmp:2908: the many cries, birth-pangs and contractions (chevalim ve-tzirim) of a woman in labor — image for the groans preceding any deed of divine service
tmp:2909: the moment 'before she gives birth' — the pre-birth stage of the birthing woman, analogue of the difficult pre-beginning of an avodah
tmp:2911: the needed many cries (kalin) and groans (genichot) — the preparatory sighs/oy-vey sounds and strange movements God-fearers make before a deed
tmp:2912: the stage 'before one begins any beginning' — the hardest pre-initiation moment prior to starting a new divine service
tmp:2913: nadvan — the donor/philanthropist, one who gives charity; specifically one whose giving must be avodah, not mere natural kindness
tmp:2914: the act of breaking one's cruelty (achzariyut) and inverting it into compassion (rachmanut) — the essential inner work of tzedakah
tmp:2915: the initial stage of beginning to donate to charity — the first act of volunteering tzedakah, when cruelty must first be broken
tmp:2916: the renewal and rectification of the brain/mind (moach) — restored mochin achieved through the yeshivah gathering of faith
tmp:2919: me'irat einayim — 'illuminating the eyes,' the lung's (re'ah) property of brightening the judge's sight; acronym for 'tokho ratzuf ahavah mi-bnot Yerushalayim'
tmp:2920: the blowing wind/breath of the lung (re'ah) that fans and cools the heart's heat — respiratory action effecting tikkun ha-mishpat
tmp:2923: the state of the lung (re'ah) being in wholeness/completeness — its intact cold-and-moist condition enabling all the aforementioned rectifications
tmp:2924: the effecting of all the aforementioned aspects (faith, mochin-tefillin, judgment) as a result of the lung's wholeness
tmp:2925: 'good for the mochin' — the beneficial state for the mentalities produced by self-abandoning love of God (casting oneself into mire), granting perception above the mind
tmp:2926: shenah metukah — 'sweet sleep' (Eccl. 5:11, 'metukah shenat ha-oved,' acronym Moshe): the good residual-impression sleep when the mochin depart
tmp:2928: tikkun ha-shenah — the rectification of sleep, i.e., of the impression-state left when the mochin/Moshe-daat withdraw, via the yeshivah
tmp:2929: the elevation of the 'sealed flesh' (hechtim besaro, seal of the sitra achra on the brit) up to the level of mochin — the operation constituting tikkun ha-brit
tmp:2930: tikkun ha-gerim — the rectification of converts (made through gatherings of faith), which in turn effects the rectification of the covenant
tmp:2932: the opposite/inverse of pride (ga'avah) — humility as the antithesis of arrogance, associated with shaking out the cloaks
tmp:2933: chotam di-kedushah — the seal of holiness, identified with tefillin ('seal the Torah among my disciples'), opposite the seal of the Other Side
tmp:2935: kibbutzei ha-emunah — the gatherings/collections of faith, assemblies through which the portions of emunah are gathered and converts are made
tmp:2936: the gathering of students around the Rav — the disciples' assembling by their master (the 'yeshivah'), which collects the portions of faith
tmp:2937: the being-gathered and collected of the scattered portions/parts of faith (chelkei ha-emunah) — result of the students' gathering to the Rav
tmp:2939: the Ten Days of Repentance (Aseret Yemei Teshuvah) — the Rosh Hashanah–Yom Kippur period during which the tefillin-rectification is effected
tmp:2940: tikkun ha-tefillin — the rectification of the tefillin/mochin (seal of holiness), wrought in the Ten Days and completed on Yom Kippur
tmp:2942: the gathering of all the holy congregations (kehillot kedoshot) on Rosh Hashanah — 'Your faithfulness in the assembly of holy ones,' collecting faith
tmp:2943: the watering/quenching of the heart — giving drink to the burning heart ('lev nishbar,' 'yishberu pera'im tzema'am') as tikkun ha-mishpat via shevarim
tmp:2944: extinguishing the aforementioned heat — cooling/quenching the heart's burning (like a lit flame) caused by corrupted judgment
tmp:2945: ish tevunah — the 'man of understanding' who is cool of spirit (Prov.), the figure through whom faith is rectified (tekiah aspect)
tmp:2947: kishur ha-merkavah — the 'binding of the Chariot': tying the Chariot-angels (Raphael, Gabriel, etc.) to repair the merkavah's blemish, source of fallen loves
tmp:2948: being saved/rescued from the aforementioned impurity (nocturnal defilement from perverted judgment) — deliverance effected by binding the Chariot before sleep
tmp:2949: the requirement to bind the Chariot ('merkavo argaman') — the bedtime kishur ha-merkavah practice as sole tikkun for the impurity of perverted judgment
tmp:2951: the rectified and strengthened power of the angel — the angel's force fortified (through joy/tefillin-mochin) to prevail over harm
tmp:2952: hitchadshut ha-ratzon — the renewal of the divine Will, primarily in Nisan, when the angels' appointment/strength is renewed
tmp:2953: the act of renewing the Will (through joy) — arousing angelic joy year-round as though the ratzon were newly renewed that day
tmp:2954: eating in the mode of joy — that one's eating itself be done in simchah, an aspect of the joy that strengthens the angel
tmp:2955: the twofold effect of strengthening the angel and subduing the demons (shedim) — accomplished through joy/tefillin-mochin
tmp:2956: the remedy for a bad dream — the halakhic tikkun (a fast, ta'anit) prescribed when a person dreams an ill dream
